uutiset.t: Quant Funds Are Having a Hard Time Keeping Up With This Market
uutiset.s: The stock market narrative is shifting so quickly, even the so-called fast money can’t keep up.

uutiset.t: Bond Traders Rush to Hedge Risk of Fed Hikes Stalling Economy
uutiset.s: Bond traders are racing to hedge the risk that the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate hikes and the stock market’s slide will significantly slow the US economy, forcing the central bank to shift back to easing monetary policy as soon as late next year.

uutiset.t: Escalation in Iran Appears As the Default
uutiset.s: The US and Israel assassinated Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, the only man with the authority to force an unpalatable compromise like a deal with Washington on regime hardliners. That leaves escalation as the default, Bloomberg Opinion columnist Marc Champion says. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Dell Raises AI Server Outlook as Backlog Hits Record $132 Billion | Closing Bell
uutiset.s: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Nvidia Option Trader Scores 1,984% Gain After CEO Huang’s Return
uutiset.s: Reddit user Outrageous-Voice1459 made a lot of money on Monday.

uutiset.t: Russian Pleads Not Guilty in Snooping Case Targeting Palantir
uutiset.s: A Russian national pleaded not guilty to US charges that he acted as a foreign agent who covertly sought information about workers at Palantir Technologies Inc. over Ukraine’s wartime use of the company’s software.

uutiset.t: JPMorgan Sets Below Consensus S&P 500 Target of 8,200 for 2027
uutiset.s: JPMorgan Chase & Co. strategists see US stocks advancing through the end of 2027, with artificial intelligence remaining a driving force behind earnings growth.

uutiset.t: Netflix Buys Seinfeld Studio Lot After Goldman Forecloses
uutiset.s: Netflix Inc. announced it’s buying Radford Studio Center, the historic Los Angeles lot where Seinfeld was filmed, for $380 million after Goldman Sachs Group Inc. took control of the property.

uutiset.t: Advent Weighs Takeover Of Testing Firm Bureau Veritas
uutiset.s: Advent is considering a bid to acquire French testing firm Bureau Veritas SA, people with knowledge of the matter said, in what would be one of the largest buyouts of a European company this year.

uutiset.t: Canadian Dollar Gains Most Since August on BOC Inflation Warning
uutiset.s: The Canadian dollar is headed for its biggest gain in more than three months after the head of the Bank of Canada warned higher oil costs will further drive up consumer prices, compounding persistent inflation.

uutiset.t: Quant Funds Reduce US Treasury Short Bets, Fueling Bond Rally
uutiset.s: Trend-chasing quant funds are trimming their long-held short positions in US Treasuries, fueling a bond rally as an equity selloff revives haven demand for government debt.

uutiset.t: Bank of Canada Shakes Up Core Measures, Focuses on 2% Inflation Target
uutiset.s: The Bank of Canada is changing the metrics it uses to weigh underlying price pressures as part of its new monetary policy framework, Governor Tiff Macklem said.

uutiset.t: Brazil Real Gains on Reports Lula Backs More Spending Curbs
uutiset.s: The Brazilian real gained on Tuesday on reports that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is backing moves to curb fiscal spending, easing the concerns about the budget deficit that have dragged the currency down since his surprise re-election.

uutiset.t: Anthropic Shares Plunge Below IPO Price in Fourth Trading Day
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC shares traded below their $83 initial public offering price for the first time, wiping out gains for investors who piled into the artificial intelligence lab’s record-setting debut last week.

uutiset.t: Nasdaq 100 Tumbles as Nvidia Euphoria Fades, New Tariffs Loom
uutiset.s: The Nasdaq 100 Index plunged on Tuesday, led by another steep decline in chipmakers as a relief rally in technology stocks gave way to renewed worries about the durability of the AI trade. Plans for new US tariffs also weighed on stocks.
